First Appeared: @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.SUWNsmWvbkJyVUMV]{Session 6}
Status: Active
Affiliation: @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{The Light}, @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold}

Description

The administrator who runs the operations of the Light's church in @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold}, assigning clergy and paladins to their posts.
An old "bean counter" who has known @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic} since boyhood and trusts his intuition.

Role

He confirmed to Roderic that many of the faithful have vanished overnight without sign of struggle, and that scholars have found inconsistencies in scripture and history.
He could no longer remember the hero @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Ps9BeVM23C49daxv]{Sariel} even when Roderic described him, but he trusted Roderic that a hero of that name had once existed.
Frightened by the dustless patch where Sariel's bust had stood, he now sleeps with a ceremonial dagger at his side.

Relationships

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Sir Roderic Lightbearer} — Has known him since boyhood; a sympathetic contact within the church hierarchy, who has long owed Gregory a favor whose origin is unspoken
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{The Light} — Administrator of its Beaconhold operations

Key Events

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.SUWNsmWvbkJyVUMV]{Session 6} — Confirmed the vanishings and the unraveling of scripture; revealed the impossible dustless patch where Sariel's bust had stood; could not remember Sariel but trusted Roderic's testimony

Session Appearances

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.SUWNsmWvbkJyVUMV]{Session 6}
